content.comment_body: Hello, I am testing the app and web server control features. I can activate each one individually, but not both at the same time. For instance, when I turn on the web server and then try to enable app control, only the most recent selection remains active, and the previous one switches off automatically. Is it only possible to use one at a time, or am I missing something?
From my experience, you can only have one activated at a time since both functions use the same communication port. For an official answer, I recommend submitting a support request.

I followed your advice and contacted support. It turns out that others have asked about this too. Here’s the response I received: 'This issue has already been reported to headquarters and is currently being addressed by engineering. It will likely be fixed in one of the upcoming updates.' More information will follow.

analysis.insight_summary: Users discovered that both app control and web server control cannot be enabled at the same time on the product. Activating one causes the other to automatically deactivate. This behavior is recognized as a limitation by the service department, which has stated that a fix is planned for a future update. The primary user concern is the inability to use both control interfaces together.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to enable and use app control and web server control at the same time without any issues or conflicts.
